title: Disk out of inodes
symptoms: No space left on device, but df -h shows free space. df -i shows 100% inodes used. Millions of tiny files in a temp or session folder.
root_cause: An app creates many small files (sessions, cache, mail queue) and never deletes them.
impact: No new files can be created, so services fail to write.
fix_steps: Find the folder with most files: find / -xdev -type f | cut -d/ -f2-3 | sort | uniq -c | sort -n.
Delete old temp or session files.
Fix the app to clean up its files.
prevention: Alert on inode usage as well as bytes.
